findings.summary: Items count as live while expires >= now, so an item is still returned exactly ttl seconds after it was stored, unlike TTLCache and unlike expire().
`key in cache` goes through __getitem__, which marks the item as used, so membership checks change which item is evicted.
Eviction counts the key being stored, so replacing the value of a key already in a full cache evicts another item.

The lookup in __getitem__ appends _LIVE after AND without parentheses, and _LIVE is an OR, so the query reads (key = ? AND expires IS NULL) OR expires > ? and a missing key returns whichever item with a ttl has not expired yet.
